summary: Wrote a 6-phase plan: build, test and register a standing script-inventory probe (Phases 1-3), then three bounded behaviour-preserving lib/ extractions from orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh against a pre-captured --dry-run baseline (Phases 4-6).
